welcomeMessage: Welcome to Dr. Consultations. To assist Dr. with your upcoming appointment, please answer a few quick questions (takes ~1 minute).

steps.question: Is this a new orthopedic issue or a follow-up for a previous visit?
Which body part is affected? (e.g. Right Knee, Lower Back, Left Shoulder, Ankle, Neck)
How did the pain or problem start?
How long have you been experiencing this? (e.g. 3 days, 2 weeks, 6 months)
On a scale of 1 to 10, how severe is your pain currently?
What movements or activities make the pain worse or better? (e.g. walking, resting, bending)
Are you experiencing any of these symptoms?
Have you had any prior injury or surgery to this area?
What medications, pain relief, or home treatments have you already tried? (Type 'none' if none)
Do you have any recent X-ray, MRI, or prescription photos? Please take a photo and send it now, or type 'none'.
Can you currently walk, climb stairs, or bear weight normally?
How has your recovery been since your last visit? Any new concerns or improvements?
Do you have any new X-rays, scan reports, or medication lists to share? Send photo or type 'none'.
